prerequisites: Willingness to reflect on personal learning habits
quiz_adaptations: Focus on foundational concepts due to low scores in learning_style, logical_reasoning, mathematical, and motivation topics
Include more visual and interactive elements to support different learning styles
Provide motivational content to address lack of engagement

modules.title: Understanding Your Learning Style
modules.description: This module introduces learners to various learning styles (visual, auditory, kinesthetic) and helps them identify their preferred method of absorbing information.
objectives: Understand how learning styles affect study strategies
Begin applying tailored techniques to improve retention

sub_modules.title: Introduction to Learning Styles
sub_modules.description: Learn what learning styles are and why they matter in effective studying.
learning_outcomes: Define visual, auditory, and kinesthetic learning
Recognize characteristics of each learning style

activities.title: Learning Style Assessment Quiz
activities.description: Take an interactive quiz to determine your primary learning style.
learning_objectives: Self-assess learning preferences through guided questions

activities.title: Video: Exploring Learning Styles
activities.description: Watch a short animated video explaining different learning styles with real-world examples.

sub_modules.title: Applying Learning Styles to Study Techniques
sub_modules.description: Discover specific study methods that align with your identified learning style.
learning_outcomes: Match learning styles to effective study tools

activities.title: Interactive Matching Game
activities.description: Play a game where you match study techniques to learning styles.
learning_objectives: Recognize appropriate study tools per learning style
prerequisites: Completion of Introduction to Learning Styles

activities.title: Personalized Study Plan Creation
activities.description: Use templates to build a weekly study plan using your preferred learning style.
learning_objectives: Apply knowledge practically by creating custom plans

modules.title: Building Logical Reasoning Skills
modules.description: Develop critical thinking abilities through structured logic exercises designed for beginners.
objectives: Enhance ability to make logical deductions from given data
Apply reasoning in everyday decision-making scenarios

sub_modules.title: Fundamentals of Logic
sub_modules.description: Explore basic principles of logic including premises, conclusions, and valid arguments.

activities.title: Logic Puzzle Workshop
activities.description: Solve simple puzzles focusing on cause-effect relationships.

activities.title: Reading Comprehension Exercises
activities.description: Read short passages followed by questions testing inference and deduction.
learning_objectives: Make logical inferences based on evidence

sub_modules.title: Real-World Application of Logic
sub_modules.description: Translate learned logic into practical use cases like evaluating news articles or making decisions.

activities.title: News Article Analysis Exercise
activities.description: Critique sample news stories for bias and logical consistency.

activities.title: Decision Matrix Practice
activities.description: Use a decision matrix tool to evaluate options logically when faced with choices.
prerequisites: Completion of News Article Analysis Exercise

modules.title: Foundations of Mathematical Thinking
modules.description: Strengthen core math skills essential for academic success, especially if struggling with mathematical reasoning.
objectives: Improve confidence in solving basic arithmetic problems
Build foundation for advanced mathematical concepts

sub_modules.title: Number Sense and Operations Review
sub_modules.description: Refresh understanding of addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, decimals, and percentages.
learning_outcomes: Convert between forms (e.g., fraction to decimal)

activities.title: Interactive Math Drills
activities.description: Engage with timed drills focused on mental math practice.
assessment_criteria: Consistent correct answers over multiple rounds

activities.title: Fraction and Decimal Conversion Chart Activity
activities.description: Create and utilize conversion charts as memory aids.

sub_modules.title: Word Problems and Critical Math Applications
sub_modules.description: Translate word-based situations into solvable equations while reinforcing computational fluency.

activities.title: Story Problem Solving Guide
activities.description: Follow step-by-step instructions to dissect complex story problems.
prerequisites: Completion of Number Sense and Operations Review

activities.title: Budget Simulation Activity
activities.description: Manage hypothetical budgets involving income, expenses, savings, and percentages.
learning_objectives: Apply mathematics to realistic financial contexts
prerequisites: Completion of Story Problem Solving Guide
assessment_criteria: Explanation of choices made during simulation

modules.title: Motivation and Goal Setting
modules.description: Cultivate intrinsic motivation and develop SMART goals to sustain long-term learning efforts despite time constraints.

sub_modules.title: Understanding Motivation Types
sub_modules.description: Differentiate internal vs external motivators and explore their impact on persistence.

activities.title: Motivation Inventory Self-Assessment
activities.description: Reflect on past successes and failures to uncover what inspires action.
learning_objectives: Gain insight into individual motivational triggers

activities.title: TED Talk Reflection Session
activities.description: Watch inspiring talks about overcoming procrastination and building discipline.
learning_objectives: Relate messages back to personal growth journey
assessment_criteria: Connection drawn to own life context

sub_modules.title: Creating Actionable Goals Using SMART Framework
sub_modules.description: Transform vague aspirations into measurable milestones using the SMART criteria.

activities.title: SMART Goals Template Exercise
activities.description: Fill out goal-setting worksheets aligned with short-term and long-term ambitions.
assessment_criteria: Fully filled worksheet with meaningful entries
Instructor approval of clarity and specificity

activities.title: Weekly Planner Integration
activities.description: Incorporate newly created SMART goals into a digital or paper planner system.
prerequisites: Completion of SMART Goals Template Exercise
